naming_rules.rule: must state consistency level and conservative denominator
must state consistency level and conservative denominator
must state whether consistency, vuln, judged, or smoke
must state which precision and recall denominators are paired
vuln-level precision is a companion diagnostic, not the paper main table
must state the frozen 252-case conditional denominator
must not be named dev252 recall
must carry reportable=false and old-protocol status
must not be used as accuracy, recall, or precision

forbidden_comparisons.reason: different sample, protocol, tuning history, and negative pool
173/1465 answers coverage, not the dev252 denominator
completion measures execution, not vulnerability detection
one case can contribute multiple claims
stage2 quality is not stage3 reproduction

paper_contract: Main table contains only the four canonical consistency metrics with CI, coverage, protocol, and publishable status.
Vulnerability-level metrics appear only as explicitly named companion diagnostics and never replace the consistency main table.
dev252 appears only as a development retrospective; 68.7% is conditional recall over 252 cases and 11.8% is a separate coverage-aware lower bound.
A+/hardened smoke appears only as an appendix diagnostic and must carry reportable=false and protocol mainline/1.6.1.
Precision must be named as consistency, vuln, judged, or smoke; bare "precision" is not acceptable.
Completion, stage2 quality, and claim-level verdicts must not be presented as end-to-end case-level performance.
